persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make me an 8-second looping video wallpaper for my phone, 9:16. Soft blue and purple glowing ribbons moving slowly on a dark background. Leave the top third mostly dark for the clock. No words or sound, and no jump when it loops.
bank.Source image: Generate it from scratch; no photo.
bank.Style and colours: Soft abstract glowing ribbons in blue and purple against a dark background.
bank.Composition: Keep the top third mostly dark and place most of the ribbons below it so the clock stays readable.
bank.Duration and motion: 8 seconds, slow flowing motion, and a seamless repeat.
bank.Text and audio: No words, clock graphic or sound; my phone supplies the clock.

messages.text: Could you make me a looping video wallpaper for my phone with soft blue and purple glowing ribbons moving slowly against a dark background? I’ve been wanting to freshen up my phone because I look at it so often throughout the day. I mean an 8-second video in vertical 9:16, with a slow flowing motion rather than anything abrupt. Please generate it from scratch, not from a photo, and leave the top third mostly dark with most of the ribbons below it so the clock stays readable. I worry a little about wallpapers making my screen feel cluttered. There should be no words, clock graphic, or sound, since my phone supplies the clock, and the repeat should be seamless with no jump when it loops.
